smallestPublishedIndexRetrieval.countOnly: GET title_table blob only; gunzip and inspect point_ids count and aligned columns.
smallestPublishedIndexRetrieval.denseShortlistInputs: GET title_table and mix_vectors, only those two of10 published blobs; SHA1 checks on gzipped bytes, bounded bytes from manifest, decode int8 matrix+float32 per-dimension scales and require exact point_id order equality.
smallestPublishedIndexRetrieval.fingerprintBlocker: Published index contains peer centroids, not per-title raw/normalized fingerprint arrays. fp+dense ablation needs separately existing catalog/Qdrant candidate signal artifact; those were not located.
smallestPublishedIndexRetrieval.first: One SELECT manifest FROM search_index_builds WHERE build_id = ? against explicit reviewed build (current pointer only if captured/frozen once); bind raw manifest bytes/SHA/build_id and file SHA1/bytes.
smallestPublishedIndexRetrieval.negationAndCuts: Additionally GET negation_labels for actual label penalty, alternate_cuts for actual cut folding; word_frequencies/collocations if faithfully reproducing preparation text rules. Needed exact set depends reviewed offline ablation scope.
smallestPublishedIndexRetrieval.readOnlyAuthority: Existing app loader uses POST /_sql with SELECT-only manifest read and GET blob reads; documented validated from webapp host in #142. This is a retrieval proposal, not authorization or an executed request.
smallestPublishedIndexRetrieval.remainingBlocker: No per-corpus query encodings in published index. intent_examples contains fixed39 intent vectors, not168 corpus vectors. Under no-model/no-network rule retrieval alone cannot complete cosine evaluation.
smallestPublishedIndexRetrieval.urlTemplate: GET /_blobs/search_index_files/<manifest sha1> on existing Crate HTTP endpoint; loader follows bounded redirects and authenticates, never print credentials.
